title: Enforce one plan-wide reference operation budget
finding: ReferenceContractionInterpreter forwarded the full max_operations allowance independently to every Compose and Hadamard node. A multi-step plan could therefore execute several individually bounded contractions whose cumulative work exceeded the interpreter budget.
primary_claim: ReferenceContractionInterpreter now threads one remaining operation allowance through the whole expression evaluation, so the configured max_operations bound applies cumulatively to the complete logical plan rather than separately to each operator.
gardener_decision: Thread an integer remainder through the existing recursive oracle instead of adding a scheduler, planner state object, parallel budget abstraction, or backend API. Direct TypedRelationBlock operation limits keep their existing per-call contract.
acceptance: a two-compose plan that needs two reference operations refuses when max_operations is one even though each individual compose needs only one operation
the same plan succeeds at the exact cumulative boundary of two operations
direct relation-block operation limits retain their existing per-call behavior
existing Fourfold revision and semiring compatibility checks remain authoritative
no OwnerApproval, promotion, gate transition, or benchmark superiority claim is created

verification.claim: Only exact-head executed workflow steps count as evidence.
